changelog:
- monday connector skill for operating monday.com through the OOMOL-connected account via the `oo` CLI.
- Supports core board, item, workspace, dashboard, doc, form, group, column, update, team, user, and department workflows.
- Covers both read and write operations, including create, update, move, duplicate, archive, and list actions.
- Includes destructive actions with explicit safety guidance so state-changing requests are handled carefully.
- Uses live connector schemas before running actions, keeping payloads aligned with the authoritative monday contract.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@3e4b3ff`
summary: monday (monday.com). Use this skill for ANY monday request — reading, creating, updating, and deleting data. Whenever a task involves monday, use this skill instead of calling the API directly.
